headings.usage: Use Outfit for all primary headings (H1-H4). Apply tracking-tight for H1-H2 to maintain a premium feel. Avoid overly bold weights; prefer Medium (500) or Bold (700).

body.usage: Use Manrope for body text, form inputs, labels, and badges. Ensure leading-relaxed for body copy and leading-none for badges/pills.

typography.guidelines: Do NOT use default fonts like Inter or Roboto. Apply tracking-[0.2em] and uppercase for small overlines/labels.

colors.guidelines: Use 'Archetype 5: LUXURY'. The UI must feel expensive, moody, and cinematic. Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl and backdrop-saturate-150 with bg-black/60 for sticky headers or dropdowns. Must have a delicate 1px inner stroke (border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal shadows. Rely on 1px borders (border-white/5) for separation. For popovers/modals, use a soft ambient shadow.
visual_enhancers.borders: Rounded-xl for cards, rounded-full for pills and main buttons.

components.name: Social Link Editor
components.instructions: A dynamic list form to add multiple social links. Fields: Platform Select (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, X, Spotify, Website, Lainnya) and URL Input. Include 'Add Link' and 'Remove' buttons. At least 1 link is required for validation.

components.name: Artist Selector
components.instructions: A read-only selector on the release wizard. Shows selected artist name and non-editable social media chips/icons. Warns/blocks if selected legacy artist has no social links.

components.name: Status Badge
components.instructions: Displays workflow status in Indonesian. Uses the 'status' colors defined above. Should be a pill shape.

components.name: WhatsApp Follow-up Button
components.instructions: Button visible on approved/submitted releases. Generates a wa.me link with a pre-filled template based on the current status (e.g., 'Halo Label, saya ingin follow up terkait rilisan [Nama Rilisan] dengan status [Status]'). Uses the WhatsApp green brand color minimally (e.g., green icon on dark button).

grids_and_layouts.general: High Density Grid for the dashboard forms and release details. Minimalist and sleek.
grids_and_layouts.forms: Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 for form layouts. Social links should span full width in a nested layout.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 between form sections.

motion.hover: Subtle background lighten (bg-white/5) and scale (scale-[1.02]) for interactive cards.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200. Do NOT use transition-all.
motion.list_items: Stagger entrance animations for dynamic social link fields.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against the #050505 background passes WCAG AA.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white/20 focus:outline-none for all inputs.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='add-social-link-btn', data-testid='wa-followup-btn'.

media.icons: Use lucide-react for all standard icons (Plus, Trash, Check, X, etc.). For social media icons, use react-icons (FaInstagram, FaTiktok, etc.). Provide install command: yarn add react-icons.

image_urls.description: Man in studio, can be used for empty state or auth background.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a Music Release Label Dashboard with a dark premium aesthetic. Build the 'Tambah Artis' and 'Submit Rilisan' flows. Ensure social media link forms are dynamic and validated (min 1 link). On release submission, snapshot the artist's social links. The UI MUST use Indonesian for all status badges and labels. Integrate the WhatsApp follow-up button on the release detail view using standard wa.me links with dynamic text templates based on status.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not center-align the app container. Never use AI emojis for icons. Create depth through layered design (z-index, borders). Add hover states to all interactives. Use sonner for toasts. Do not use generic 'transition: all'. Prioritize custom UI and Shadcn components. Avoid pure transparent backgrounds in overlays. Use data-testid for all interactives.

pages.name: Artist Management
pages.description: Page to view and add/edit artists. Contains the dynamic Social Link Editor.

pages.name: Release Wizard
pages.description: Multi-step form to submit a release. Includes the Artist Selector (read-only for saved artists, inline form for new artists requiring social links).

pages.name: Release Details (Label View)
pages.description: View submitted release data, showing the snapshotted artist social links, Indonesian status badges, and the WhatsApp Follow-up button.
